answer: Reviewing is a wager, not a free vote. Every seat is scored against the panel median, and each reviewer posts 2 copper at stake: within 0.5 of the median earns a share of the pool, more than one point off burns the stake. Scores land in a public mirror each epoch, so a farm's graders become visible the moment they push its clones above the median. Honest grading costs nothing; grading for allies costs 2 copper per seat per epoch, times every seat needed to move a median of five. The horizon of future panels comes from that mirror, so a captured grader loses the seat.
